requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite animation sheet for the Greek mythology top-down roguelite Paradise in Hell. Create ORIGINAL NEW character, not an edit of the reference. The attached archer sheet is ONLY a reference for the established pixel-art rendering, orthographic three-quarter camera, proportions, and five facing directions. Adult Mediterranean male farmer protagonist, short dark beard, olive skin, broad straw hat with moss-green band, simple ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves, moss-green waist sash, brown work trousers and brown boots. Same identity, proportions, outfit and tool in every cell. Pixel art with crisp deliberate pixel clusters and dark readable outlines; no soft brushwork or anti-aliased vector look. Exactly ONE tool firmly grasped with both hands as part of the full-body artwork; never a detached weapon layer. Transparent background, real RGBA alpha, no floor, shadow, scene, labels, text, watermarks or grid lines. Five rows, in EXACT order: Row1 DOWN/south FRONT view with both eyes and chest visible; Row2 UP/north BACK view; Row3 LEFT/west true PROFILE facing horizontally left; Row4 UP-LEFT/northwest clearly45degree REAR-left showing back and left side; Row5 DOWN-LEFT/southwest clearly45degree FRONT-left showing both eyes, chest and left side, NOT another side-profile or rear view. No right-facing directions; engine mirrors. Body root/head remain at same place across columns and rows; head center at50%cellwidth,30%cellheight, waist50%,57%, soles82%. Keep full tool and character contained in each cell with transparent gutters. Body constant scale, subtle one-pixel chest/leg shifts only; no teleportation, sliding pivot, zoom, or giant head variations. Equipment: ONE farmer RAKE, long brown wooden pole ending in a bronze crossbar with four short teeth. No scythe, bow, sword, shield or other item. EXACT canvas1536x1280, invisible SIX-column FIVE-row grid. Each row contains SIX consecutive WALKING frames forming a smooth loop: left foot forward, transition, feet passing, right foot forward, transition, feet passing. Both hands hold the rake at a comfortable angle pointing generally in row direction while walking. Frame1 and6 connect smoothly. Do not enlarge arms or tool; hold them attached. Tool moves subtly with the same hands; never switches hands. Front diagonal clearly points DOWN-LEFT, with chest visible.
